summary: This experimental RFC describes AugPAKE, a password-only authentication and key exchange for IKEv2 where the server stores a verifier rather than the password. It is designed so attackers cannot run offline dictionary searches against captured exchanges.

eli5.summary: You prove you know a secret word without saying it, and the checker only keeps a scrambled version. A thief cannot guess your word from it.

questions: how to use password only authentication in ikev2
